scenarios.name: normal_operation
scenarios.ground_truth: Normal operational state across all zones
scenarios.description: All metrics nominal; zero packet drops or flaps.

scenarios.name: link_congestion
scenarios.ground_truth: Link utilization saturation causing buffer queue drops and latency spikes
scenarios.description: Throughput exceeds 92% bandwidth on core trunk, queue drops > 500.

scenarios.name: weak_wifi_signal
scenarios.ground_truth: Hostel access point RF attenuation causing high retransmissions and packet loss
scenarios.description: RSSI drops below -82 dBm, Wi-Fi retransmission rate > 25%.

scenarios.name: ethernet_interface_fault
scenarios.ground_truth: Physical layer Ethernet interface CRC errors and flapping transitions
scenarios.description: Department switch interface errors > 2000, link flaps > 5.

scenarios.name: dns_failure
scenarios.ground_truth: DNS resolution service outage with high query timeout failure rate
scenarios.description: DNS failure rate > 80%, resolution latency > 2500ms.

scenarios.name: dhcp_failure
scenarios.ground_truth: DHCP scope exhaustion or relay failure preventing lease assignment
scenarios.description: DHCP failure rate > 75%, host reaches degraded state.

scenarios.name: device_cpu_overload
scenarios.ground_truth: Control-plane CPU exhaustion on core router driving queue drops
scenarios.description: CPU utilization > 95%, memory > 85%, queue drops on router.

scenarios.name: upstream_failure_cascade
scenarios.ground_truth: Core router failure causing failover saturation on distribution links
scenarios.description: Upstream link down cascades into downstream buffer starvation.

scenarios.name: ambiguous_multi_fault
scenarios.ground_truth: Simultaneous contradictory signals without decisive root cause
scenarios.description: Multiple competing faults present; confidence must remain below threshold.

scenarios.name: insufficient_data
scenarios.ground_truth: Telemetry data is too sparse to substantiate any definitive fault hypothesis
scenarios.description: Single incomplete record; must strictly return insufficient_evidence.

scenarios.name: interop_renamed_fields
scenarios.ground_truth: Field alias adaptation (dev_id, delay, loss, util)
scenarios.description: Telemetry keys renamed to test adapter mapping.

scenarios.name: interop_seconds_vs_ms
scenarios.ground_truth: Time unit conversion from seconds to milliseconds
scenarios.description: Latency metric provided in fractional seconds.

scenarios.name: interop_kbps_vs_mbps
scenarios.ground_truth: Rate conversion from kbps to Mbps
scenarios.description: Throughput provided in kbps.

scenarios.name: interop_schema_v1_vs_v2
scenarios.ground_truth: Schema version tag divergence tolerance
scenarios.description: Schema version 2.0.0 experimental envelope.

scenarios.name: interop_missing_fields
scenarios.ground_truth: Graceful degradation under missing optional metrics
scenarios.description: Optional fields omitted entirely.

scenarios.name: interop_null_nan
scenarios.ground_truth: Sanitization of string 'NaN' and 'null' values
scenarios.description: Unsanitized null strings present in telemetry.

scenarios.name: interop_duplicate_out_of_order
scenarios.ground_truth: Chronological sorting and deduplication
scenarios.description: Duplicate records and reverse timestamp order.

scenarios.name: interop_clock_skew
scenarios.ground_truth: Clock skew detection and time window normalization
scenarios.description: Extreme clock offset between records.

scenarios.name: interop_malformed_json
scenarios.ground_truth: Lenient parsing of single-quoted / unformatted JSON
scenarios.description: Single-quoted raw JSON input.

scenarios.name: compound_cpu_and_link
scenarios.ground_truth: Simultaneous Router CPU overload and Link Congestion
scenarios.description: Two concurrent fault signatures trigger conflict resolution fallback.

scenarios.name: compound_wifi_and_dns
scenarios.ground_truth: Simultaneous Wi-Fi attenuation and campus-wide DNS failure
scenarios.description: Dual simultaneous wireless and DNS service degradations.
